normalization.arrayOrdering: Sort semantic operation IR by category, intent, owner, and operationId.
normalization.valueEncoding: Keep only value, source, and evidence references; discard display labels and prose.
normalization.time: Normalize all durations, delays, and intervals to milliseconds.
normalization.percent: Normalize all ratios to basis points.
normalization.references: Normalize references to namespace plus stable ID, proposed local key, or unresolved candidate keys.

equivalent: The same semantic intent and selected mechanism produce the same target, time points, numeric values, and reference identity.
Operation order differences disappear when no ordered-group dependency exists.
Different labels, descriptions, operation IDs, and display formatting do not affect equivalence.
notEquivalent: Different interval, duration, damage, layer, count, or decay values.
Buff interval damage versus Trap interval damage when lifecycle behavior is part of the assertion.
Existing reference versus proposed new reference with the same display name.
Status Ready versus NeedsClarification or Unsupported.

assertionPolicy.required: Every golden case must assert status and at least one semantic outcome or rejection reason.
assertionPolicy.forbidden: A forbidden assertion fails when its matching IR fragment is present.
